object.name: evi.transratio
object.digest: Convert semitones to pitch and vica versa
object.description: Like the <o>transratio</o> abstraction but with multiple choices for input/output conversion. Clamps internally so that output never produces -inf or nan.

inlets.digest: Input in either pitch, octave, semitones, cents or ratio
inlets.description: Set the input type with the @in attribute or the first argument to the object. (bang) retriggers the last used inlet value.

outlets.digest: Output value in either ratio, semitones, hz or pitch
outlets.description: Set the output type with the @out attribute or the second argument to the object.

attributes.name: base
attributes.description: Set the tuning for the conversion around A = 440.

attributes.name: in
attributes.description: symbol, one of: pitch, octave, semitones, cents, ratio. Sets the input to the convertor.

attributes.name: offset
attributes.description: Hz and pitch convertion assume middle C = 60. Via @offset you can change this to anything you need.

attributes.name: out
attributes.description: symbol, one of: ratio, semitones, hz, pitch. Sets the output from the convertor.
